reviews.text: The level of care, assistance, compassion and friendliness from Shania was honestly second to none. I cannot thank her enough for all of her time and patience she spent on me throughout the day. From the minute I called to the 50 minutes spent in store, she could not have been any more helpful. We have an 18 week Basset hound who has been a little unwell due to his current food. Shania went over every food brand she would recommend for our boy and gave her honest opinions which helped us make the decision on the best food for our puppy. She was so down to earth I could have cried that someone actually took the time to listen and spend time going over everything with me. She doesn't know how much she made my day. Fingers crossed our pup gets better after his new food, treats and toys. Customer care and compassion was 10/10. Xx

The Groomer there, whose name sadly I didn't catch, removed several ticks, which I had found really difficult to get and was charged only £3. Then Elaine helped me again find the right treatments for his follow up and was just so kind and efficient, he also loves his Lemon toy that he got with his Pets at Home voucher. Staff member Elaine was quite a gem when I visited. Went in to get a full start up for a Rabbit as it was my daughter's first time getting a pet. Elaine was the cashier, I spoke to her about getting some assistance, she spoke to someone through the headset she had on. Shortly after, she came stated that she got relieved from the register. She asked if I've ever had a rabbit before, which I stated no. Without hesitation, she started educating us about rabbits, told us what to expect and not to be alarmed about. Then she brought me to get the things, still educating us. She was so kind and friendly. I asked her about the plan they have for the vet and such, again, she wasted no time grabbing a brochure and bringing us to the area where she introduced us to the receptionist to get started. Elaine made our visit an excellent, calm, smooth and rewarding one. Only problem, the store seemed short staff as Elaine has had to excuse herself to attend to other duties/customers. The store was clean and smelled clean as well.
